body.question: The Great Enclosure at Great Zimbabwe has dry stone walls as high as 11 m (36 ft). What holds the stones together?
options: Nothing: the walls were built without mortar
body.reveal: The Great Enclosure's dry stone walls were constructed without mortar. It was built during the 13th and 14th centuries and likely served as the royal residence. More than 400 such sites with monumental, mortarless walls have been identified across southern Africa.

probes.question: Roughly how many sites like Great Zimbabwe, with monumental mortarless walls, have been identified across southern Africa?
True or false: the Great Enclosure was built during the 13th and 14th centuries.
